sloka: तद्राक्षसानीकमतिप्रचण्डमालोक्य रामो भुजगेन्द्रबाहुः ।विभीषणं शस्त्रभृतां वरिष्ठमुवाच सेनानुगतः पृथुश्रीः ।। ६.५९.११ ।।।।
transliteration: tadrākṣasānīkamatipracaṇḍamālokya rāmo bhujagendrabāhuḥ ।vibhīṣaṇaṁ śastrabhṛtāṁ variṣṭhamuvāca senānugataḥ pṛthuśrīḥ ।। 6.59.11 ।।।।

translations.english: Rama, whose arms were like the king of serpents, shining with splendour, followed by army, seeing the army of Rakshasas exceedingly furious, spoke to Vibheeshana the foremost of the wielder of weapons.
